name: NaughtyList
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A big thick closed ledger book bound shut with a chunky chain wrapped around it and a big round padlock on the front, a scroll of paper curling out of the pages. Kid-friendly villain prop, single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Deep red leather cover with gold corner caps, cream pages and scroll, grey steel chain, shiny gold padlock. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: One mesh; Chain and Lock are helper parts so the contract names exist.
